body:
While living in South America I had two experiences with coca tea. The first batch I brewed myself from commercially-produced coca tea bags.  This resulted in a decent herbal tea but no significant psychoactive effects.
A month later I was having breakfast in a La Paz cafe and ordered  some coca tea.  Floating in the cup when it arrived were a half-dozen fresh leaves.  This tasted much better.  It also produced a stimulant buzz similar to caffeine but 'cleaner' - more cerebral and less physical.  I would describe it as a mild feeling of lightness and euphoria that dissipated to baseline within half an hour.
I concluded there that there was really no contest: fresh whole leaves produced the superior tea.
